//! Generates demo/tests/fixtures/marks.json: `metalbook_maker::mark` on a grid of inputs.
//! Built against metalbook origin/main (see demo/tests/fixtures/README.md).
use std::str::FromStr;

use metalbook_core::{
    OptionKind, OuncesPerContract, SeriesKey, SeriesTerms, StrikeUsd, Underlying, UnixTimestamp,
};
use metalbook_maker::{mark, MarketInputs, OptfixPricer};
use rust_decimal::Decimal;

const USD: u64 = 1_000_000;
const EXPIRY: i64 = 1_794_603_600;
const WINDOW_S: u32 = 1_800;

fn main() {
    // (underlying, kind, strike, cap, multiplier in milli-ounces)
    let mut series: Vec<(Underlying, OptionKind, u64, u64, u32)> = Vec::new();
    for k in [48u64, 49, 50, 51, 52] {
        series.push((Underlying::Xag, OptionKind::Call, k * USD, k * USD * 11 / 10, 1_000));
    }
    series.push((Underlying::Xag, OptionKind::Put, 50 * USD, 0, 1_000));
    series.push((Underlying::Xag, OptionKind::Call, 50 * USD, 55 * USD, 50_000));
    series.push((Underlying::Xau, OptionKind::Call, 4_000 * USD, 4_400 * USD, 1_000));
    series.push((Underlying::Xau, OptionKind::Put, 4_000 * USD, 0, 1_000));
    let xag = ["45.5", "52.84681", "60.125"];
    let xau = ["3800.5", "4131.857", "4500"];
    let times = [1_793_900_000i64, 1_794_500_000, 1_794_601_000];
    let vols = ["0.30", "0.18"];
    println!("[");
    let mut first = true;
    for s in &series {
        let spots = if s.0 == Underlying::Xag { &xag } else { &xau };
        for spot in spots {
            for now in times {
                for vol in vols {
                    let key = SeriesKey::try_new(
                        s.0,
                        s.1,
                        StrikeUsd::new(s.2),
                        UnixTimestamp::new(EXPIRY),
                    )
                    .unwrap();
                    let terms = SeriesTerms::try_new(
                        key,
                        OuncesPerContract::try_new(s.4).unwrap(),
                        StrikeUsd::new(s.3),
                    )
                    .unwrap();
                    let market = MarketInputs {
                        spot: Decimal::from_str(spot).unwrap(),
                        vol: Decimal::from_str(vol).unwrap(),
                        rate: Decimal::from_str("0.04").unwrap(),
                        carry: Decimal::ZERO,
                        now,
                        market_open: true,
                    };
                    let m = mark(&OptfixPricer, &terms, &market, WINDOW_S).unwrap();
                    if !first {
                        println!(",");
                    }
                    first = false;
                    print!(
                        "  {{\"underlying\":\"{}\",\"kind\":\"{}\",\"strike\":{},\"cap\":{},\"multiplier\":{},\"expiry\":{},\"window_s\":{},\"spot\":\"{}\",\"vol\":\"{}\",\"rate\":\"0.04\",\"carry\":\"0\",\"now\":{},\"value\":\"{}\",\"max_payout\":\"{}\"}}",
                        if s.0 == Underlying::Xag { "XAG" } else { "XAU" },
                        if s.1 == OptionKind::Call { "call" } else { "put" },
                        s.2, s.3, s.4, EXPIRY, WINDOW_S, spot, vol, now, m.value, m.max_payout
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }
    println!("\n]");
}
